description: Composite summary of four independent carrier-machinery measures, and the GO decision table artifact
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, json, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# ---- last attempt at a GO source that includes IEA ----
try:
    r=requests.get('https://api.geneontology.org/api/bioentity/gene/UniProtKB%3AQ9Y6C9/function',
                   params={'rows':100},timeout=25)
    print('GO API status',r.status_code, str(r.text)[:300])
except Exception as e:
    print('GO API (api.geneontology.org) unreachable:',str(e)[:120])

# ---- composite summary figure from the four computed axes (all values computed in iterations 1-2) ----
mot=pd.read_csv('motif_census_full.csv')
qb=pd.read_csv('glutamine_brace_retention.csv')
dom=pd.read_csv('domain_repeat_counts.csv')
sco=pd.read_csv('mtch2_carrier_motif_scores.csv')
sb=pd.read_csv('saltbridge_geometry.csv')

grp=lambda c: 'canonical SLC25' if c=='canonical SLC25' else 'MTCH clade'
mot['g']=mot['class'].map(grp); qb['g']=qb['class'].map(grp)
dom['g']=dom['class'].map(lambda c:'canonical SLC25' if 'canonical' in c else 'MTCH clade')
sco['g']=sco.protein.map(lambda p:'MTCH clade' if p.lower().startswith('mtch') else 'canonical SLC25')

panels=[('Matrix PX[DE]XX[KR] motifs\n(per protein)', mot,'PxDxxKR',3),
        ('Glutamine braces retained\n(of 3 conserved AAC1 Q)', qb,'n_Q',3),
        ('PROSITE SOLCAR repeats\ndetected', dom,'PROSITE_SOLCAR_copies',3),
        ('AAC1 diagnostic positions\nretained (% of 27)', sco.assign(pct=sco.pct),'pct',100)]
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,4,figsize=(15,4.5))
for ax,(title,d,col,ymax) in zip(axes,panels):
    vals=[d[d.g=='canonical SLC25'][col].values, d[d.g=='MTCH clade'][col].values]
    bp=ax.boxplot(vals,labels=['canonical\nSLC25','MTCH\nclade'],widths=0.55,patch_artist=True,showfliers=False)
    for patch,c in zip(bp['boxes'],['#2a7f62','#c0392b']): patch.set_facecolor(c); patch.set_alpha(0.45)
    for i,v in enumerate(vals):
        ax.scatter(np.full(len(v),i+1)+np.random.default_rng(i).uniform(-0.12,0.12,len(v)),v,
                   s=22,color=['#2a7f62','#c0392b'][i],zorder=3)
    ax.set_title(title,fontsize=9); ax.set_ylim(-0.05*ymax,ymax*1.12)
    ax.set_ylabel('count' if ymax==3 else 'percent',fontsize=8)
    n0,n1=len(vals[0]),len(vals[1])
    ax.text(0.5,-0.18,f'n={n0}',transform=ax.transAxes,ha='center',fontsize=7)
plt.suptitle('Four independent measures of SLC25 carrier machinery: canonical carriers vs the MTCH clade',fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# ---- artifact: GO decision table ----
go=[
 ('GO:0032977','membrane insertase activity','MF','IDA (PMID 36264797, reconstituted proteoliposomes)','RETAIN as core MF','Direct reconstitution with purified protein; cryo-EM groove (PDB 12OY) gives the mechanism'),
 ('GO:0005741','mitochondrial outer membrane','CC','IDA (PMID 20436477, 36264797)','RETAIN as core CC','Outer membrane location is itself incompatible with the SLC25 matrix/cytoplasm alternating-access cycle'),
 ('GO:0045040','protein insertion into mitochondrial outer membrane','BP','IDA','RETAIN as core BP','Directly downstream of the MF; specific child term preferred over generic protein targeting'),
 ('GO:0022857 / GO:0005215','transmembrane transporter activity / transporter activity','MF','family inference only','DO NOT ADD; block family-based propagation','No PX[DE]XX[KR] motifs, no matrix gate, no substrate contact points, no reconstituted transport assay'),
 ('GO:1990letter','any specific solute transport MF (e.g. ATP:ADP antiporter)','MF','none','DO NOT ADD','No candidate substrate has been identified or assayed for MTCH2'),
 ('GO:0017128 / scramblase','phospholipid scramblase activity','MF','MD simulation only (PMIDs 37645813, 38377988)','HOLD, do not annotate','In silico prediction; needs an in vitro scrambling assay with purified MTCH2 proteoliposomes'),
 ('GO:0043065','positive regulation of apoptotic process','BP','ISS; mutant phenotype PMID 20436477','TREAT AS NON-CORE / downstream','tBID recruitment defect is plausibly a consequence of failed insertion of OMM clients'),
 ('GO:0055088','lipid homeostasis','BP','ISS','TREAT AS NON-CORE / downstream','Metabolic phenotype, several steps from the molecular activity'),
 ('GO:0010635','regulation of mitochondrial fusion','BP','ISS','TREAT AS NON-CORE / downstream','Fusion machinery components are MTCH2 insertase clients'),
]
GD=pd.DataFrame(go,columns=['GO_term','label','aspect','evidence_basis','recommended_action_LEAD','rationale'])
GD.to_csv('GO_decision_table_MTCH2.csv',index=False)
print('\nGO decision table written:',GD.shape)
print(GD[['GO_term','label','aspect','recommended_action_LEAD']].to_string(index=False))
